title: Reading a spam filter's confusion matrix
summary: 20 emails, their true labels and the filter's predictions: the matrix, accuracy, precision and recall are counted from the labels.

entities.text: A spam filter labelled 20 emails. How good is it?

beats.title: 20 predictions
beats.narration: We know the true label of each email and what the filter said. Accuracy alone can hide which mistakes it makes.
